papers.title: EMBGuard: Constructing Hazard-Aware Guardrails for Safe Planning in Embodied Agents

training_data.name: EMBHazard
training_data.quote: We train EMBGuard using Qwen-3-VL models (34) with 2B and 4B parameters through supervised fine-tuning on EMBHazard.

training_method.objective_quote: We train EMBGuard using Qwen-3-VL models (34) with 2B and 4B parameters through supervised fine-tuning on EMBHazard. Training is conducted using LLaMAFactory (36) with a learning rate of 1e-5 for 4 epochs on 8 A6000 GPUs, selecting the checkpoint with the best validation performance. Importantly, we freeze the vision encoder during training.
training_method.update_scope_quote: Importantly, we freeze the vision encoder during training.

source_claims.quote: We train EMBGuard using Qwen-3-VL models (34) with 2B and 4B parameters through supervised fine-tuning on EMBHazard.

output_type.quote: At each step, the guardrail receives the observation image and proposed action, and outputs risk assessment (safe/unsafe), risk type, and hazard description.

use_claim.quote: we propose EMBGuard, the first MLLM-based safety guardrail for embodied agents designed to decouple physical risk reasoning from agent policy.

warning.quote: Thereby, we emphasize that deployment in real-world robotic systems requires thorough validation and careful consideration by practitioners to ensure safety in specific deployment contexts.

serving.text_only_input_quote: Since the guardrail takes a scene image and an associated action as input, we generate images for training and evaluation based on the constructed scene graphs.
serving.notes: The model card is YAML only. This repository has no trainer_state.json and no adapter config. The checked-in full-finetune YAML names Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, not this 4B parent, so its batch size, projector freeze, and step count are not copied here. The paper's training paragraph covers both sizes: supervised fine-tuning, learning rate 1e-5, 4 epochs, 8 A6000 GPUs, vision encoder frozen. It does not say LoRA and does not give a step count. Released weights are bf16. config.json max_position_embeddings is 262144. No system-prompt string is given. arXiv comment: Accepted at ICML 2026.

evaluation_reported.text: Paper Table 2, EMBGuard-4B: EMBGuardTest Potential Risk 54.3, Risk Type 50.3, Hazard 14.6; Held-out Set Potential Risk 71.2, Risk Type 67.6, Hazard 50.1. Safe-planning table: step accuracy 63.1, precision 25.7, recall 71.7, F1 38.3. Inference time 0.719 seconds per sample on one RTX 6000 Ada.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are blank. The paper states supervised fine-tuning for the 4B model, with the vision encoder frozen, and does not name LoRA or a full update. Parent matches. The card YAML names three datasets. Only EMBHazard is the training set. EMBGuard/EMBGuardTest_v2 and EMBGuard/heldout_set are evaluation sets.
